title: Dialogue Actions Conduct (private)
tagline: Stricter rules for when NPCs run vanilla dialogue scripts.
description: Component C of the Errand Bridge build (spec §11.2, §11.12.2, §11.14.3, §6.5 CF-1). Replaces the TriggerDialogueLine description (components/dialogue_action.prompt) with clear-intent, clarify, decline-and-steer and consequential-line rules, and blacklists follower-command, marriage, RDO, Serana and custom-follower dialogue scripts so those go through gated actions only. Private; never published.
author: shae
